label: レビュー：モデリング・シミュレーション
classification: A review focused on mathematical models, membrane module or process simulation, model assumptions, numerical methods, validation, and uncertainty.
instructions: Compare models by purpose, assumptions, dimensionality, computational cost, and validation evidence. Keep model predictions distinct from experimental measurements.

sections.heading: 🗾このレビューの要点
sections.instruction: Summarize the main modeling conclusions and practical guidance.

sections.heading: 🧮モデルの種類と適用範囲
sections.instruction: Classify model families, dimensions, numerical approaches, and the questions each can answer.

sections.heading: ⚖️仮定と非理想効果
sections.instruction: Describe governing assumptions and nonideal phenomena included or omitted.

sections.heading: ✅検証と不確実性
sections.instruction: Summarize validation data, error measures, uncertainty treatment, and limitations.

sections.heading: 🧭モデル選択の指針
sections.instruction: State how model fidelity should be chosen for the intended design question.

sections.heading: 🔍今後の課題
sections.instruction: List author-stated needs in data, model integration, validation, and computation.
